Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim file purposes. Can you confirm
you're comfortable with us recording this statement?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Great. Can you walk me through what happened in the parking lot?
A: I was backing out of a space near the store entrance. It was a busy afternoon and the lot was pretty crowded. I
checked my mirrors, but I didn't see the other vehicle coming down the aisle until I was already rolilng back.
Q: Which part of your vehicle made contact with the other car?
A: The rear bumper on my side, just behind the driver's door. The other car's front corner hit it.
Q: Were you moving quickly at the time?
A: No, I was going slowly, maybe walking speed. I had just started to reverse.
Q: Did you stop after the impact, and what did you do next?
A: Yes, I stopped right away. The other driver got out and we exchanged information. Someone from the store also
came over and asked if we were okay.
Q: Tell me about your injuries. Where do you feel pain?
A: My right knee. I twisted it when the car jolted, and I braced myself against the door frame. It swelled up that
evening and it's been hard to bend it since.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment for the knee?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same night, and I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week. I'm also using a
brace when I walk around.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident or your injuries?
A: Just that I'm trying to get back to normal, and I'd appreciate it if this could move along as smoothly as possible.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>
